exposure: Correctable triggers of recurrent neonatal atrial flutter
Underlying substrates for recurrent neonatal atrial flutter
cohort: Neonates diagnosed with recurrent atrial flutter at a single institution.
finding: Four neonates with recurrent atrial flutter were identified, each linked to either a correctable trigger or an underlying substrate, which guided individualized therapy, and antiarrhythmic medication was required when no clear trigger was present.
